name: University of Chicago
character: The 217-acre campus is split by a large linear park and features Victorian and Collegiate Gothic quadrangles alongside modern, brutalist, and glass-domed buildings.

landmarks.name: Main Quadrangles
landmarks.quote: what are now known as the Main Quadrangles
landmarks.look: Six Victorian and Collegiate Gothic quadrangles bordering one larger quadrangle.

landmarks.name: Mitchell Tower
landmarks.quote: Mitchell Tower, for example, is modeled after Oxford's Magdalen Tower
landmarks.look: Gothic-style stone tower modeled after Oxford's Magdalen Tower.

landmarks.name: Hutchinson Hall
landmarks.quote: the university Commons, Hutchinson Hall, replicates Christ Church Hall.
landmarks.look: Gothic-style university commons hall replicating Christ Church Hall.

landmarks.name: Regenstein Library
landmarks.quote: the Regenstein Library, the largest building on campus, a brutalist structure
landmarks.look: Massive brutalist library building, the largest structure on campus.

landmarks.name: Joe and Rika Mansueto Library
landmarks.quote: the glass dome-shaped Joe and Rika Mansueto Library
landmarks.look: Modern library topped with a large glass dome over a reading room.

landmarks.name: Laird Bell Law Quadrangle
landmarks.quote: including the Laird Bell Law Quadrangle (a complex designed by Saarinen)
landmarks.look: Modernist law school complex arranged around a quadrangle.

landmarks.name: Stagg Field
landmarks.quote: beneath the viewing stands of the university's Stagg Field.

landmarks.name: Hitchcock Hall
landmarks.quote: Hitchcock Hall, an undergraduate dormitory, is on the National Register of Historic Places.
